name: prerequisite-gap
how_to_use: Returns None when the learner model has no weak concepts, so the question is simply not asked.

question.instructions: Does the student's NEW message depend on a concept listed under 'weak concepts' in the student profile?

criteria.true: the question builds on, or directly involves, one of the weak concepts
criteria.false: the question is about something else

state_shape: see P.build_state(...) - only the user's/student's own words
wiring:
from backend.app.decider import patterns as P
from backend.app.decider.client import get_client
from backend.app.decider.calibration import get_thresholds

thr = get_thresholds()
decisions, ask = P.run_patterns(get_client(), state, [P.prereq_gap(weak_concepts)], thr.get)   # ONE round trip for all patterns
d = decisions["prereq"]
if d.triggered:          # plain Python owns the control flow
    ...                  # prepend a prerequisite nudge to the prompt
note: Returns None when the learner model has no weak concepts, so the question is simply not asked.
